name: C0015 | R01 | Office Spawning a Script Host or Shell
description: Detects an Office process (WINWORD/EXCEL/POWERPNT) spawning a script host or shell (mshta/cmd/powershell) via Sysmon E1 - the macro hand-off of the entry phase (S1, T1204.002/T1059.005).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS1 initial access: the document macro launches the script host. Building block: ON.`n`n## Data and schedule`n`nSysmon Operational, index logs-windows.sysmon_operational-c0015*. Interval 1m, look-back 5m.`n`n## Investigation`n`nConfirm the parent is the Office process and the child is a script interpreter; the chain continues with R02/R07.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
process where event.code == "1"
  and event.type == "start"
  and process.parent.name : ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe")
  and process.name : ("cmd.exe", "mshta.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")

name: C0015 | R02 | Script Host Spawning Regsvr32 or Rundll32
description: Detects mshta/cmd/powershell spawning regsvr32 or rundll32 (E1) - the transition from the HTA bootstrap to the signed-proxy loader (S1, T1218.010).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS1 proxy execution after the HTA runs. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nMatch the child command line - regsvr32 /s with a staged path feeds R03.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
process where event.code == "1"
  and event.type == "start"
  and process.parent.name : ("mshta.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe")
  and process.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")

name: C0015 | R03 | Proxy Loader Loading an Unsigned Module from a Staging Path
description: Detects regsvr32/rundll32 loading an unsigned module from a staging path (E7) - the DLL surrogate load (S1, T1218.010).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS1 DLL-as-JPG load. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nCheck Signed=false + hash; correlate with E11 of the staged file and the subsequent beacon (R05/R06).
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
any where event.code == "7"
  and process.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
  and winlog.event_data.Signed : "false"
  and file.path : ("?:\\Users\\Public\\*", "?:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Desktop\\*")

name: C0015 | R04 | Script or Proxy Writing to a Staging Path
description: Detects script/proxy processes writing to staging paths (%PUBLIC%, temp, ProgramData) via E11 - catches the macro self-write and tool drops (S1/S2/S10, T1105).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nAny staged file write in the intrusion (macro-written config/HTA/beacon, downloaded DLL, collection zips). Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nReview the written file names and the writing process; a write by WINWORD into %PUBLIC% is the entry-document pattern.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
file where event.code == "11"
  and process.name : ("mshta.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
  and file.path : ("?:\\Users\\Public\\*", "?:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Desktop\\*")
  and not (process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and file.name : "__PSScriptPolicyTest_*")

name: C0015 | R05 | Regsvr32 or Rundll32 Spawning PowerShell
description: Detects regsvr32/rundll32 spawning powershell (E1) - the DLL surrogate hands off to the session beacon (S2, T1218.010).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS2 beacon launch. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nJoin the child entity with E3 egress (R06) to confirm the C2 callback.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
process where event.code == "1"
  and event.type == "start"
  and process.parent.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
  and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")

name: C0015 | R06 | Script Host Network Egress
description: Detects a script host (powershell/mshta/cmd) initiating an egress connection (E3) - the beacon callback channel (S2-S3, T1071.001). Suppressed by entity to tolerate the polling loop.
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nBeacon C2 traffic. Building block: ON; suppression (entity, 5m) keeps the polling loop from flooding.`n`n## Investigation`n`nFilter by destination port/interval; regular polling to one endpoint is the session signature.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
network where event.code == "3"
  and network.direction == "egress"
  and destination.ip != null
  and destination.port != null
  and process.name : ("mshta.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
  and process.entity_id != null and not process.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")

name: C0015 | R07 | Office to Mshta to Proxy Loader
description: Sequence: Office -> mshta -> regsvr32/rundll32 (E1 chain, entity join) - the complete entry hand-off (S1).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS1 three-step chain. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nA full match is the entry signature; partial matches still worth review.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=120s
  [process where event.code == "1"
     and event.type == "start"
     and process.name : "mshta.exe"
     and process.parent.name : ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe")
     and process.entity_id != null and not process.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.entity_id
  [process where event.code == "1"
     and event.type == "start"
     and process.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
     and process.parent.name : "mshta.exe"
     and process.parent.entity_id != null and not process.parent.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.parent.entity_id

name: C0015 | R08 | Unsigned Module Load Followed by a PowerShell Child
description: Detects a process that loads an unsigned module (E7) and then spawns powershell (E1 subsystem) - loader-to-beacon hand-off (S1/S2).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS1/S2 unsigned-library hand-off. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nConfirm module hash and the child entity; chain into R06/R09.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=120s
  [any where event.code == "7"
     and process.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
     and winlog.event_data.Signed : "false"
     and file.path : ("?:\\Users\\Public\\*", "?:\\Windows\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Downloads\\*", "?:\\Users\\*\\Desktop\\*")
     and process.entity_id != null and not process.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.entity_id
  [process where event.code == "1"
     and event.type == "start"
     and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
     and process.parent.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
     and process.parent.entity_id != null and not process.parent.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.parent.entity_id

name: C0015 | R09 | Proxy-Spawned PowerShell Making a Network Connection
description: Detects powershell spawned by a signed proxy making a network connection (E1 then E3, entity join) - beacon callback (S2-S3).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS2-S3 callback after proxy hand-off. Building block: ON.`n`n## Investigation`n`nSame entity vs R18 (which adds the rundll32/regsvr32 parent); treat as the session indicator.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
query:
sequence by host.id with maxspan=120s
  [process where event.code == "1"
     and event.type == "start"
     and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
     and process.parent.name : ("regsvr32.exe", "rundll32.exe")
     and process.entity_id != null and not process.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.entity_id
  [network where event.code == "3"
     and network.direction == "egress"
     and destination.ip != null
     and destination.port != null
     and process.name : ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
     and process.entity_id != null and not process.entity_id : ("", "{00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000}", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000")
  ] by process.entity_id

name: C0015 | R10 | PowerShell Spawning Nested CMD Processes
description: Detects powershell spawning cmd.exe (E1) - the beacon command-execution pattern (S4).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS4 task execution. Building block: ON; suppression (host+entity, 5m).`n`n## Investigation`n`nNested cmd from the beacon entity is expected during discovery batches; isolate large bursts.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.

name: C0015 | R11 | Nested CMD Launching a Discovery-Capable Tool
description: Detects cmd.exe (nested) launching a discovery-capable tool (net/nltest/whoami/tasklist) via E1 - the discovery batch (S4, T1057/T1069 etc.).
author: C0015 Lab
note: ## Scope`n`nS4 discovery. Building block: ON; suppression (host+entity, 5m).`n`n## Investigation`n`nCombine with R10/R12 for the full powershell->cmd->tool chain.
false_positives: Legitimate use of the same living-off-the-land binaries.
